name: halfnine
description: Your PostgreSQL connections in Halfnine, for Claude: describe and query them, and propose changes you approve in Halfnine.
long_description: Halfnine is a small PostgreSQL client for macOS and Windows. This extension lets Claude use the connections you saved in it. Each connection sets what agents may do there: Off, Read, Read with approved writes, or Full. Queries always run read-only. A change at Read with approved writes opens in Halfnine as staged rows or SQL, and waits for you to answer. Columns you hide never reach Claude. Install Halfnine first, from its releases page.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: The saved PostgreSQL connections, with what agents may do on each.

tools.name: describe
tools.description: A database's schemas, tables, columns and foreign keys, or one table in full.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Runs one statement that reads, in a read-only transaction.

tools.name: change_rows
tools.description: Inserts, updates or deletes rows by primary key, approved in Halfnine where the connection asks for it.

tools.name: change_structure
tools.description: Changes a table's structure in one transaction, approved in Halfnine where the connection asks for it.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Runs statements that write in one transaction, approved in Halfnine where the connection asks for it.

tools.name: wait_for_approval
tools.description: Keeps waiting for the person's answer to a staged change.
